groups.title: EV Chargers

groups.intro: Charge your EV at home, fast and safe, installed by licensed electricians. A stage 2 hardwire install of an owner-provided charger is $675 and includes the load calculation, the dedicated circuit and breaker, and programming and calibration. Most installs run $850 to $2,500 depending on the job.

services.text: Most installs run $850 to $2,500. The final price depends on panel capacity, the distance from the panel, trenching or wall penetration, and utility requirements.

groups.title: Backup Power
groups.summary: Standby generators, transfer switches, interlock kits and battery backup systems, installed and commissioned.
groups.intro: A standby generator is permanently installed and connected to your electrical system, and the automatic transfer switch detects an outage and switches your power over automatically. Battery systems do the same thing silently with no fuel. Powertex is Tesla and Generac certified, and financing is available on residential and commercial systems.
groups.imageAlt: A Powertex Electric electrician servicing a Generac standby generator in a back yard

services.title: Standby Generator Installation
services.text: Automatic standby generators and transfer switches that restore power the moment the grid fails. No extension cords, no manual startup, running on natural gas or propane.

services.title: Portable Generator Interlock
services.text: A mechanical safety device on the main panel that stops the main breaker and the generator breaker being on at once. A code-compliant alternative to a transfer switch, operated manually.

services.title: Battery Backup Systems
services.text: Battery systems that store electricity and supply power the instant the grid goes down, with no fuel, noise or exhaust, and safe to install indoors or in a garage.
points: Load analysis and critical circuit setup

about.title: A Texas family-owned electrical contractor.
text: Powertex Electric is a Texas family-owned electrical contracting company built on over 20 years of leadership and experience in the electrical industry. Powertex brings big-project expertise to homeowners, businesses and builders across Weatherford, Parker County and the greater DFW region.

Our background includes extensive work on large-scale commercial projects and high-rise residential construction, giving us a deep understanding of complex electrical systems, multi-phase scheduling, safety standards and precision installation. From hospitals and stadiums to luxury residential towers and major infrastructure projects, our experience ensures every job, big or small, is completed with the highest level of craftsmanship and professionalism.

At Powertex Electric we combine industry-leading knowledge with Texas values: honesty, reliability and pride in every detail. Whether we are upgrading a home, wiring a commercial space, installing a service panel or delivering a full design-build solution, our team is committed to code-compliant, long-lasting electrical work you can trust.

facts.heading: Battery backup or a standby generator
facts.text: Batteries are silent and instant, need no fuel, and suit short to moderate outages. A standby generator runs longer on fuel and suits extended outages. Many customers choose a battery and generator hybrid system.
